mapper.sql: SELECT t.id AS team_id, t.race AS race_id, 'leader' AS role FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT tms.team AS team_id, tms.race AS race_id, 'member' AS role FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( -- 通过name匹配的第二课堂奖状 SELECT a.id FROM award a WHERE a.name = (SELECT name FROM user_info WHERE id = #{userId}) AND a.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL -- 通过team_id匹配的奖状 SELECT a.id FROM award a INNER JOIN (
) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL -- 通过user匹配的第二课堂奖状 SELECT ar.id FROM award_records ar WHERE ar.user = #{userId} AND ar.status = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0 ) all_awards

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT t.id AS team_id FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT tms.team AS team_id FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0 ) user_teams

SELECT semesters.period, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(scores.raceScore, 0) + COALESCE(scores.projectScore, 0) + COALESCE(scores.teamScore, 0) + COALESCE(scores.roleScore, 0) + COALESCE(scores.awardScore, 0)), 0) AS compositeScore, COALESCE(SUM(scores.raceScore), 0) AS raceScore, COALESCE(SUM(scores.projectScore), 0) AS projectScore, COALESCE(SUM(scores.teamScore), 0) AS teamScore, COALESCE(SUM(scores.roleScore), 0) AS roleScore, COALESCE(SUM(scores.awardScore), 0) AS awardScore FROM ( -- 硬编码近3个学期 SELECT '2024-09' AS period UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02' AS period UNION ALL SELECT '2025-09' AS period ) semesters LEFT JOIN ( -- 计算各学期得分 SELECT CASE WHEN t.create_time BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2025-01-31' THEN '2024-09' WHEN t.create_time BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-02' WHEN t.create_time BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN '2025-09' END AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT t.race) AS raceScore, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) * 0.5 AS projectScore, COUNT(*) * 0.2 AS teamScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.leader = #{userId} THEN 1 END) * 0.3 AS roleScore, 0 AS awardScore FROM team_info t WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND ((t.leader = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.team = t.id AND tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0)) GROUP BY period UNION ALL -- 获奖得分（通过team_id匹配的奖项） SELECT CASE WHEN a.create_time BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2025-01-31' THEN '2024-09' WHEN a.create_time BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-02' WHEN a.create_time BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN '2025-09' END AS period, 0 AS raceScore, 0 AS projectScore, 0 AS teamScore, 0 AS roleScore, SUM( CASE WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%一等%' THEN 10 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%二等%' THEN 7 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%三等%' THEN 5 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%优秀%' OR a.award_level LIKE '%优胜%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END * CASE ri.level WHEN 4 THEN 3.0 WHEN 3 THEN 2.5 WHEN 2 THEN 2.0 WHEN 1 THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END ) AS awardScore FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_info t WHERE t.id = a.team_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND ((t.leader = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.team = t.id AND tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0)) ) GROUP BY period UNION ALL -- 获奖得分（通过name匹配的第二课堂奖项） SELECT CASE WHEN a.create_time BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2025-01-31' THEN '2024-09' WHEN a.create_time BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-02' WHEN a.create_time BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN '2025-09' END AS period, 0 AS raceScore, 0 AS projectScore, 0 AS teamScore, 0 AS roleScore, SUM( CASE WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%一等%' THEN 10 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%二等%' THEN 7 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%三等%' THEN 5 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%优秀%' OR a.award_level LIKE '%优胜%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END * 1.0 -- 默认级别权重 ) AS awardScore FROM award a WHERE a.name = (SELECT name FROM user_info WHERE id = #{userId}) AND a.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY period UNION ALL -- 获奖得分（通过user匹配的第二课堂奖项） SELECT CASE WHEN ar.award_date BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2025-01-31' THEN '2024-09' WHEN ar.award_date BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-07-31' THEN '2025-02' WHEN ar.award_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN '2025-09' END AS period, 0 AS raceScore, 0 AS projectScore, 0 AS teamScore, 0 AS roleScore, SUM( CASE WHEN ar.award_level LIKE '%一等%' THEN 10 WHEN ar.award_level LIKE '%二等%' THEN 7 WHEN ar.award_level LIKE '%三等%' THEN 5 WHEN ar.award_level LIKE '%优秀%' OR ar.award_level LIKE '%优胜%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END * 1.0 -- 默认级别权重 ) AS awardScore FROM award_records ar WHERE ar.user = #{userId} AND ar.status = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY period ) scores ON semesters.period = scores.period GROUP BY semesters.period ORDER BY semesters.period ASC

SELECT award_level AS awardLevel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( -- 通过name匹配的第二课堂奖状 SELECT a.award_level FROM award a WHERE a.name = (SELECT name FROM user_info WHERE id = #{userId}) AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.award_level IS NOT NULL AND a.award_level != '' UNION ALL -- 通过team_id匹配的奖状 SELECT a.award_level FROM award a INNER JOIN (
) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.award_level IS NOT NULL AND a.award_level != '' UNION ALL -- 通过user匹配的第二课堂奖状 SELECT ar.award_level FROM award_records ar WHERE ar.user = #{userId} AND ar.status = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0 AND ar.award_level IS NOT NULL AND ar.award_level != '' ) all_awards GROUP BY award_level ORDER BY award_level ASC

SELECT ri.race_type AS raceType, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.id) AS count FROM (
) ut JOIN race_info ri ON ut.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ri.race_type ORDER BY ri.race_type ASC

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT ti.status FROM team_info ti WHERE (ti.leader = #{userId} OR ti.id IN ( SELECT team FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 )) AND ti.is_deleted = 0 ) user_projects GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC

SELECT COALESCE(race_score, 0) + COALESCE(project_score, 0) + COALESCE(team_score, 0) + COALESCE(role_score, 0) + COALESCE(award_score, 0) AS compositeScore FROM ( SELECT -- 1. 比赛基础分 (保持原有逻辑) (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT race_id) FROM ( SELECT t.race AS race_id FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT tms.race AS race_id FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0 ) ur) AS race_score,
-- 2. 项目参与分 (去重队伍数 × 0.5) (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) * 0.5 FROM ( SELECT t.id AS team_id FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT tms.team AS team_id FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0 ) ut) AS project_score,
-- 3. 队伍参与分 (组队次数 × 0.2) (SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0) ) * 0.2) AS team_score,
-- 4. 角色加分 (队长次数 × 0.3) (SELECT COUNT(*) * 0.3 FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0) AS role_score,
-- 5. 获奖加权分 (保持原有逻辑) (SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%一等%' THEN 10 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%二等%' THEN 7 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%三等%' THEN 5 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%优秀%' OR a.award_level LIKE '%优胜%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END * CASE ri.level WHEN 4 THEN 3.0 WHEN 3 THEN 2.5 WHEN 2 THEN 2.0 WHEN 1 THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END ), 0) FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT t.id AS team_id FROM team_info t WHERE t.leader = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT tms.team AS team_id FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = #{userId} AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 ) AS award_score ) scores

WITH student_scores AS ( SELECT ui.id AS user_id, ( -- 1. 比赛基础分 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r) FROM ( SELECT race AS r FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT race AS r FROM team_member_student WHERE student = ui.id AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) t) + -- 2. 项目参与分 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) * 0.5 FROM ( SELECT id AS team_id FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT team AS team_id FROM team_member_student WHERE student = ui.id AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) ut) + -- 3. 队伍参与分 (SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member_student WHERE student = ui.id AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0) ) * 0.2) + -- 4. 角色加分 (SELECT COUNT(*) * 0.3 FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0) + -- 5. 获奖加权分 COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%一等%' THEN 10 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%二等%' THEN 7 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%三等%' THEN 5 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%优秀%' OR a.award_level LIKE '%优胜%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END * CASE ri.level WHEN 4 THEN 3.0 WHEN 3 THEN 2.5 WHEN 2 THEN 2.0 WHEN 1 THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END ) FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ti.id AS team_id FROM team_info ti WHERE ti.leader = ui.id AND ti.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT tms.team FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = ui.id AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 ), 0) ) AS score FROM user_info ui WHERE ui.grade = CAST(#{grade} AS CHAR) AND ui.is_teacher = 0 AND ui.is_deleted = 0 ), ranked AS ( SELECT user_id, score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rnk FROM student_scores ) SELECT (SELECT rnk FROM ranked WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS `rank`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_scores) AS total

WITH student_scores AS ( SELECT ui.id AS user_id, ( -- 1. 比赛基础分 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r) FROM ( SELECT race AS r FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT race AS r FROM team_member_student WHERE student = ui.id AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) t) + -- 2. 项目参与分 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) * 0.5 FROM ( SELECT id AS team_id FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT team AS team_id FROM team_member_student WHERE student = ui.id AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) ut) + -- 3. 队伍参与分 (SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member_student WHERE student = ui.id AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0) ) * 0.2) + -- 4. 角色加分 (SELECT COUNT(*) * 0.3 FROM team_info WHERE leader = ui.id AND is_deleted = 0) + -- 5. 获奖加权分 COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%一等%' THEN 10 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%二等%' THEN 7 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%三等%' THEN 5 WHEN a.award_level LIKE '%优秀%' OR a.award_level LIKE '%优胜%' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END * CASE ri.level WHEN 4 THEN 3.0 WHEN 3 THEN 2.5 WHEN 2 THEN 2.0 WHEN 1 THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END ) FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT ti.id AS team_id FROM team_info ti WHERE ti.leader = ui.id AND ti.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT tms.team FROM team_member_student tms WHERE tms.student = ui.id AND tms.is_choosed = 1 AND tms.is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 ), 0) ) AS score FROM user_info ui WHERE ui.college = #{college} AND ui.is_teacher = 0 AND ui.is_deleted = 0 ), ranked AS ( SELECT user_id, score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rnk FROM student_scores ) SELECT (SELECT rnk FROM ranked WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS `rank`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_scores) AS total

SELECT ri.id AS raceId, ri.name AS raceName, ri.race_start AS raceStart, ri.race_end AS raceEnd, ri.join_start AS joinStart, ri.join_end AS joinEnd FROM race_info ri WHERE ri.is_deleted = 0 AND ( ri.join_end IS NOT NULL AND ri.join_end > NOW() OR ri.race_start IS NOT NULL AND ri.race_start > NOW() OR ri.race_end IS NOT NULL AND ri.race_end > NOW() ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ri.join_end IS NOT NULL AND ri.join_end > NOW() THEN ri.join_end WHEN ri.race_start IS NOT NULL AND ri.race_start > NOW() THEN ri.race_start WHEN ri.race_end IS NOT NULL AND ri.race_end > NOW() THEN ri.race_end END ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT 'race' AS eventType, ri.race_start AS eventTime, ri.name AS eventName, '参赛' AS eventDescription, ri.id AS relatedId FROM race_info ri JOIN ( SELECT race AS race_id FROM team_info WHERE leader = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT race AS race_id FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON ri.id = ut.race_id WHERE ri.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'project' AS eventType, ti.create_time AS eventTime, ti.name AS eventName, '创建项目' AS eventDescription, ti.id AS relatedId FROM team_info ti WHERE (ti.leader = #{userId} OR ti.id IN ( SELECT team FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 )) AND ti.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'award' AS eventType, COALESCE(a.create_time, NOW()) AS eventTime, COALESCE(a.race_name, '未知比赛') AS eventName, CONCAT('获得奖项，等级：', COALESCE(a.award_level, '未知')) AS eventDescription, a.id AS relatedId FROM award a WHERE a.name = (SELECT name FROM user_info WHERE id = #{userId}) AND a.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'award' AS eventType, COALESCE(a.create_time, NOW()) AS eventTime, COALESCE(ri.name, '未知比赛') AS eventName, CONCAT('获得奖项，等级：', COALESCE(a.award_level, '未知')) AS eventDescription, a.id AS relatedId FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 JOIN ( SELECT id AS team_id FROM team_info WHERE leader = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT team AS team_id FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'award' AS eventType, COALESCE(ar.award_date, NOW()) AS eventTime, COALESCE(ar.competition_name, '未知比赛') AS eventName, CONCAT('获得奖项，等级：', COALESCE(ar.award_level, '未知')) AS eventDescription, ar.id AS relatedId FROM award_records ar WHERE ar.user = #{userId} AND ar.status = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY eventTime DESC

SELECT a.id AS awardId, COALESCE(a.name, '未知奖项') AS awardName, COALESCE(a.award_level, '未知') AS awardLevel, COALESCE(a.race_name, '未知比赛') AS raceName, COALESCE(a.create_time, NOW()) AS awardTime FROM award a WHERE a.name = (SELECT name FROM user_info WHERE id = #{userId}) AND a.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL
SELECT a.id AS awardId, COALESCE(a.name, '未知奖项') AS awardName, COALESCE(a.award_level, '未知') AS awardLevel, COALESCE(ri.name, '未知比赛') AS raceName, COALESCE(a.create_time, NOW()) AS awardTime FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 JOIN ( SELECT id AS team_id FROM team_info WHERE leader = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT team AS team_id FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL
SELECT ar.id AS awardId, COALESCE(ar.competition_name, '未知奖项') AS awardName, COALESCE(ar.award_level, '未知') AS awardLevel, COALESCE(ar.competition_name, '未知比赛') AS raceName, COALESCE(ar.award_date, NOW()) AS awardTime FROM award_records ar WHERE ar.user = #{userId} AND ar.status = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY awardTime DESC

SELECT ti.id AS projectId, ti.name AS projectName, ri.name AS raceName, ti.create_time AS createTime, ti.status AS status FROM team_info ti JOIN race_info ri ON ti.race = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 WHERE (ti.leader = #{userId} OR ti.id IN ( SELECT team FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 )) AND ti.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ti.create_time DESC

SELECT 'competition' AS type, COALESCE(a.race_name, '未知比赛') AS name, COALESCE(a.create_time, NOW()) AS time, COALESCE(a.award_level, '未知') AS levelOrStatus, a.id AS relatedId, NULL AS certificateUrl FROM award a WHERE a.name = (SELECT name FROM user_info WHERE id = #{userId}) AND a.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'competition' AS type, COALESCE(ri.name, '未知比赛') AS name, COALESCE(a.create_time, NOW()) AS time, COALESCE(a.award_level, '未知') AS levelOrStatus, a.id AS relatedId, NULL AS certificateUrl FROM award a JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 JOIN ( SELECT id AS team_id FROM team_info WHERE leader = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT team AS team_id FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ) ut ON a.team_id = ut.team_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'second_class' AS type, COALESCE(ar.competition_name, '未知比赛') AS name, COALESCE(ar.award_date, NOW()) AS time, COALESCE(ar.award_level, '未知') AS levelOrStatus, ar.id AS relatedId, ar.award_url AS certificateUrl FROM award_records ar WHERE ar.user = #{userId} AND ar.status = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'project' AS type, COALESCE(ti.name, '未知项目') AS name, COALESCE(ti.create_time, NOW()) AS time, CASE COALESCE(ti.status, -1) WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '审核通过' WHEN 4 THEN '已立项' ELSE '其他' END AS levelOrStatus, ti.id AS relatedId, NULL AS certificateUrl FROM team_info ti WHERE (ti.leader = #{userId} OR ti.id IN ( SELECT team FROM team_member_student WHERE student = #{userId} AND is_choosed = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 )) AND ti.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT ui.id AS userId, ui.name AS userName, ui.college AS collegeId, cm.name AS collegeName, ui.major AS majorId, cm.major_name AS majorName, ui.grade AS grade, ui.stu_grade AS stuGrade FROM user_info ui LEFT JOIN college_major cm ON ui.college = cm.id WHERE ui.id = #{userId} AND ui.is_deleted = 0
